note: A SELF-CONTAINED, LOUDLY-NAMED test bed for the calculation engine, seeded on
tool prod because that is the only environment where Plan, Rule, Transaction
and the org data all exist together (2026-09-10).
Everything here is prefixed TEST- and every transaction carries
batchId TEST-ENGINE-SMOKE, so the whole family is findable and removable by
hand. ua-records can never update or delete, so re-running this is a no-op.
WHY A NEW PLAN INSTEAD OF REUSING 'Testing'. The two authored rules can never
fire: CR-1788881151375-8609 tests `position.title == "AP"` and no such title
exists, PR-1788863954836-1714 tests `credit.credit_type == "Booked"` and the
credit types are NEW_BOOKING/RENEWAL/EXPANSION/MGR_ROLLUP/SPIF. Rather than
edit records somebody authored, this set stands up a parallel plan whose
conditions name values that are actually in the data.
THE CHAIN THIS EXERCISES, all of it live on 5 Sep 2026:
POS-AP-AE-01  Priya Nair    T-AE    -> parent POS-AP-RSM-01 (Kenji Watanabe)
-> grandparent POS-GBL-VP-01 (Diane Whitlock)
so rollupLevels=2 has two real ancestors to walk and MGR_ROLLUP credits to write.
THE FIVE TRANSACTIONS ARE THREE POSITIVE AND TWO NEGATIVE ON PURPOSE. A run
that credits all five is as wrong as one that credits none, and only the
negatives can tell those apart:
TEST-TXN-001  POS-AP-AE-01  T-AE      MATCH   + rollup 2 levels
TEST-TXN-002  POS-AP-AE-01  T-AE      MATCH   + rollup, second deal same seat
TEST-TXN-003  POS-AE-34     T-AE      MATCH   but NO parent in the hierarchy,
so the rollup walk must end quietly
rather than fail the run
TEST-TXN-004  POS-EU-AE-05  T-AE-EU   NO MATCH - title is close but not equal
TEST-TXN-005  POS-W-AE-04   T-ENT-AE  NO MATCH - title is close but not equal
Expected: 3 direct credits + 4 rollup credits = 7 Credit rows, and payout at
500bps of each NEW_BOOKING credit. Anything else is a finding.
PERIOD. Close dates sit in Sep 2026; SEP-2026 and Q3-2026 are both OPEN, so a
run against them is legal under the period state machine. Nothing here touches
JAN-2026 (PAID) or any CLOSED month.
AMOUNTS. Transaction.amount is an `integer` property on the platform, which
docs/model/money-and-time.md says money must never be - past 2^31 paise the
runtime type changes underneath. These values are small and safe; the object
is the bug, and it is recorded, not worked around here.

Rule.name: TEST Direct credit to the AE seat (smoke, safe to delete)
Rule.description: Credits the holder of any T-AE seat with the full deal, then rolls a copy two levels up the reporting line.

result.name: TEST Direct credit to the AE seat

Rule.name: TEST Commission at 5% of new bookings (smoke, safe to delete)
Rule.description: Flat 5% on every NEW_BOOKING credit, earned on close. Deliberately does NOT pay MGR_ROLLUP, so the run has to distinguish the two credit types.

result.name: TEST Commission at 5% of new bookings

Plan.name: TEST Engine smoke plan (safe to delete)
Plan.description: Stands up a credit rule and a payout rule that match real data, so the engine can be run end to end. Parallel to 'Testing', which is left untouched.
